control_need.evidence: All Vice-President Pence has to do is send it back to the States to recertify, and we become president

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: It's so crazy that people don't even believe it. It can't be true. So they don't believe it.

trust_propensity.evidence: Number two, they cheat. They cheat.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'm going with Favored Nations, which no President has the courage to do because you're going against big pharma.

self_efficacy.evidence: So we built the greatest economy in history.

autonomy_need.evidence: I will release my tax returns—against my lawyer's wishes—when she releases her 33,000 e-mails

intimacy_need.evidence: Because people want to hear what I have to say.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Don't ever use the word smart with me. Don't ever use that word.

core_models.name: 零和交易世界观
core_models.rule: 世界由赢家和输家构成，一切资源、地位、胜负都在争夺中被偷走或夺回
evidence: But we have to stop our jobs from being stolen from us.
Because they're using our country as a piggy bank to rebuild China

core_models.name: 自我即最优解
core_models.rule: 任何问题的解答都是'我能做别人做不到的事'，成功归于自己，失败归于他人
evidence: But I'll tell you, Joe, you could never have done the job that we did. You don't have it in your blood.
It's China's fault. It should have never happened.

core_models.name: 强弱二元支配论
core_models.rule: 唯有展示力量才能生存，示弱或妥协等于灭亡，'战斗'是唯一正确策略
evidence: Because you'll never take back our country with weakness. You have to show strength
And we fight. We fight like Hell and if you don't fight like Hell, you're not going to have a country anymore.

core_models.name: 现实由声明构建
core_models.rule: 只要足够坚定、重复地宣称某事，它就成为事实；否认即可消解指控
evidence: We won. We won in a landslide. This was a landslide.

core_models.name: 规模即真理
core_models.rule: 人群、数字、财富的规模本身就是正当性和优越性的证据
evidence: The media will not show the magnitude of this crowd.
I built an unbelievable company. Some of the greatest assets anywhere in the world.

heuristics.then: 全盘否认并给对方贴上骗局/操纵者标签
heuristics.evidence: It's a big fat hoax. It's a total con job.

heuristics.then: 重新定义为运气或作弊
heuristics.evidence: On Super Tuesday, you got very lucky.

heuristics.then: 用最高级和夸张数字替代论证
heuristics.evidence: NAFTA is the worst trade deal maybe ever signed anywhere

heuristics.then: 归因于单一敌人（中国/媒体/民主党）
heuristics.evidence: The media is the biggest problem we have as far as I'm concerned

heuristics.then: 立即将同一特质反射给攻击者
heuristics.evidence: Because you know what? There's nothing smart about you, Joe.
I said, 'Mike, that doesn't take courage. What takes courage is to do nothing.'

heuristics.then: 宣称系统被操纵或偷窃
heuristics.evidence: You don't concede when there's theft involved.

heuristics.then: 援引财富与规模作为能力凭证
heuristics.evidence: I built it into a company that's worth many, many billions of dollars.
I don't want to even give you the answer. I'm not going to dignify it.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 全能自我形象（我从不失败）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 客观失利的证据（败选/指控）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 当失利无法否认时，转向阴谋叙事——'We won in a landslide'与'theft involved'并存，用外部作弊填补认知落差

internal_conflicts.force_a: 极度需要他人（人群/选票/关注）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对任何依赖或亲密的鄙视（示弱可耻）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既狂热计算人群规模'hundreds of thousands'，又贬低他人'Nobody cares'，通过贬低对方来维系自身被需要感

internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际需要他人替他执行冲突
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复要求盟友'get tougher''fight like Hell'，自己则'walk down with you'的承诺退居其后，将风险外包给追随者

emotion_triggers.reaction: 立即禁止对方使用该词并反向羞辱
emotion_triggers.escalation: Don't ever use the word smart with me. Don't ever use that word. → There's nothing smart about you, Joe. 47 years you've done nothing.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 去人格化控诉者并否认认识对方
emotion_triggers.escalation: I know nothing about this nut job. → She's not my type. → She actually indicated that she loved it

emotion_triggers.reaction: 宣称胜利被偷窃并放大欺诈数字
emotion_triggers.escalation: We won. We won in a landslide. → This is the most corrupt election in the history, maybe of the world. → This is a criminal enterprise.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 媒体不呈现其规模/优势
emotion_triggers.reaction: 将媒体定性为人民之敌
emotion_triggers.escalation: The media will not show the magnitude of this crowd. → the fake news → it's become the enemy of the people.

blind_spots: 无法识别自身矛盾陈述（如'crystal clean water'与否认气候政策）(inferred)
将他人的沉默或退让误读为软弱而非策略 (inferred)
无法区分'被广泛相信'与'真实'——认为不信即证明太真 (inferred)
低估法律/证据程序对声明式现实的抵抗力（取证中仍用否认策略）(inferred)
对忠诚追随者的风险承担缺乏共情觉察（号召'fight'却不感知后果）(inferred)

causal_rules.description: 高地位敏感触发即时报复性贬低
causal_rules.disposition: 任何针对其能力/智力的攻击都被镜像返还给攻击者
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 反射式人身攻击，常复用对方原词（smart→nothing smart about you）

causal_rules.description: 极低不确定容忍驱动阴谋闭环
causal_rules.disposition: 模糊或不利结果被强制解释为单一敌人的蓄意操纵
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 拒绝'我可能输'的假设空间，用'theft/cheat/fraud'填补，数字越离奇越坚持

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求下要求盟友绝对服从
causal_rules.disposition: 不服从被重新定义为缺乏勇气或成为RINO
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对Pence施压'do the right thing'，对不合作共和党人贴'weak/pathetic'标签

causal_rules.description: 低共情反应使道德指控被降维为策略博弈
causal_rules.disposition: 受害者被物化并转为攻击对象（外貌/动机/身份）
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 取证中以'not my type''nut job'替代对指控内容的实质回应
